tools.name: create_leave_request
tools.title: Create leave request
tools.description: Creates an annual or personal leave request for the signed-in employee and routes it to their manager. If any field is missing, opens an interactive leave request form (pre-filled with whatever is known) so the user can complete and submit it. Always confirm dates with the user before calling with all fields.

reason.description: Short reason shown to the approver

tools.name: delete_leave_request
tools.title: Delete leave request
tools.description: Deletes (withdraws) one of the signed-in employee's own leave requests that is pending, or approved but not yet started. Without a requestId, opens an interactive list of the employee's open requests so they can pick one to delete. Confirm with the user before deleting.

requestId.description: Leave request id, e.g. LR-1002. Omit to show the list.

tools.name: approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve or reject leave (managers only)
tools.description: MANAGERS ONLY. Without a requestId, lists leave requests from the manager's direct reports that are waiting for a decision. With a requestId, approves (default) or rejects that request with an optional comment. Non-managers receive an authorization error.

requestId.description: Leave request id to decide on. Omit to list pending approvals.
